title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28 (Master's, UK)
organizationName: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
description: Fully funded one-year master's scholarships in the UK for high-quality postgraduate students from Least Developed and middle-income Commonwealth countries who could not otherwise afford to study in the UK. Covers approved return airfare, full tuition fees and a monthly living allowance (£1,712, or £2,000 at London-area universities), with extra grants where applicable. Applicants apply through the CSC's online portal; the closing time is 16:00 GMT on 8 December 2026.

additionalRequirements: Citizen of, or refugee in, an eligible Commonwealth country.
Applicant's country must be on the CSC's eligible-country list.

applicationInstructions: Apply online through CSC Central. The CSC does not charge an application fee.
ugandanEligibilityQuote: Be a citizen of or have been granted refugee status by an eligible Commonwealth country.

title: Mastercard Foundation EdTech Fellowship Uganda – Cohort 2
description: A 12-month fellowship run by Hive Colab with the Mastercard Foundation for growth-stage EdTech ventures in Uganda. Fellows receive a milestone-based, equity-free grant (up to USD 70,000 according to Hive Colab), weekly mentorship and coaching, learning-science and inclusive-design guidance, investment-readiness support and up to 24 months of follow-on support. Ventures must be locally founded and led and operating mainly in Uganda.
